title: RefundsPostRequestBodyContentApplicationJsonSchemaRefund
description: Details about the refund to create.

amount.description:
The amount of money to refund the customer, in the lowest denomination of currency for the refund.

Min value: `1`

merchant_id.description:
ID of the merchant to make the refund from.

Min length: `1`
Max length: `128`

payment_id.description:
For refunds, this is the ID of the payment to refund.

Min length: `1`
Max length: `128`

capture.description:
Whether or not to automatically capture the refund once it's created.

Default: `true`

reference_id.description:
A user-defined identifier for this refund, typically used to associate the refund with a record in an external system.

Min length: `1`
Max length: `1024`

Currency.description:
Indicates the country associated with an entity. Values are from the [ISO-4217 Alpha-3](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html) specification.

Current values:

- `USD`: United States Dollar
Currency.title: Currency

Metadata.description:
Freeform key-value pairs of arbitrary data associated with this resource.

Keys and values must be passed as strings and not contain any personally identifiable information (PII).

Min keys: `0`
Max keys: `50`


> Note: Nested keys are not supported.
